findings.body: Ignored untracked files bypass this check: `--untracked-files=all` still excludes ignored files ([Git status contract](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-status)). If a differing skill file has never been committed and matches an ignore rule, `_held` sees neither status nor history and permits the write. On a nondefault branch, doctor then replaces the hand-written contents. Include ignored files when checking these specific paths, and cover their preservation through the real doctor command.
findings.title: Not done: Doctor never overwrites a change made by hand, and leaves what needs a person as one plain step

findings.body: The hold-back check examines the link's Git status and history, but the eventual write can modify its target. For example, in `repo = "forge-source"`, a committed `.claude/skills/forge/SKILL.md` link to a repository-local notes file remains clean when that target is edited by hand. History is exempt here, so doctor permits the repair. `sync.write_file` follows internal links (`src/forge/sync.py:117–123`); only AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are materialized. An in-place repair therefore overwrites the uncommitted notes. Protect the actual write target or materialize the skill link before writing, with command-level coverage.

findings.body: New evidence beyond the prior empty-file and AGENTS.md-link findings is a dangling CLAUDE.md link. `githooks.ships` omits it because `exists()` is false (`src/forge/githooks.py:74`), so this helper and doctor's hold-back loop never consider it. However, `sync.write` independently unlinks it at `src/forge/sync.py:348–356`. With no other drift, doctor reports no repair although sync would remove the link. With another repairable file on a nondefault branch, doctor calls sync and deletes even a newly created or staged dangling CLAUDE.md without checking its hand edit. Include these link-cleanup paths in the comparison and hold-back set, and cover both cases through doctor.
